title: Logic Circuits
objectives:
This course covers the design and analysis of digital logic circuits including combinatorial and
sequential logic circuits.
syllabus:
Number systems, binary systems, binary codes, addition, subtraction, multiplication and division,
Boolean algebra, theorems, logic functions, sum-of-products form, product-of-sums form,
Karnaugh maps, logic minimization using K-maps, logic gates (RTL, DTL, TTL) and related
topics (FAN-IN, FAN-OUT), combinatorial circuits design, multiplexers, decoders, comparators,
sequential circuits design, flip-flops, shift registers, counters, synchronous and asynchronous logic
circuits, finite state machines, the timing of sequential circuits
Programming language: Verilog
textbooks:
1. Morris Mano, Michael Ciletti, Digital Design. 4th ed. Prentice Hall, 2006.
2. Victor Nelson, Troy Nagle, Bill Carroll, David Irwin, Digital Logic Circuit Analysis and Design.
1st ed. Prentice Hall, 1995.
